description: Update a CTA on a video. Only the fields you pass are changed; everything else keeps its current value. Placement cannot be changed — delete and re-add the CTA instead.

append_website_query_params.description: Append the page's URL query params to the button's URL

cta_id.description: ID of the CTA to update

custom_html.description: Raw HTML/CSS/JS to render instead of the styled button (advanced)

end_time.description: Seconds into the video when the button disappears. Omit to show until the end of the video.

position.description: Button position on the video overlay. Only applies to placement='inside'.

start_time.description: Seconds into the video when the button appears. Omit (with end_time) for the whole video.

text.description: Button label text. Required unless custom_html is set.

url.description: URL opened when the button is clicked. Required unless custom_html is set.

name: panda_update_cta
title: Update CTA
